classification: retrospective controls, no independent detector or discovery claim
injection: deterministic +1 Pearson-unit waveform; refit each fixed background, subtract uninjected refit; not power

interpretation.causality: localization cannot identify detector cause without efficiency/trigger-object calibration
interpretation.low_power: in-range <1000, fewer than 8 analysis bins, or conditional |amplitude|/SE < 2
interpretation.model_dependent: flexible background reduces baseline Q or reverses amplitude; report all, do not select significance
interpretation.multiplicity: overlapping controls are descriptive; no minimum p or post-hoc discovery threshold
interpretation.selection_dependent: any sign reversal among evaluable partitions; report explicitly with counts and SE
interpretation.stable_positive: all evaluable file/sample baseline amplitudes positive under a given background

low_count_rule: retain row; do not fit if in-range pairs < 1000
mass_variant_scope: nominal for every selection; lower5 and expanded_masks for float64 only

predictive_cv.selection: minimum held-out Poisson deviance, no target score

selections: all supported historical muon HLT bits
each run split by floor(lumi/50) modulo 2

systematic_experiment.generator: shared pooled early H2/G1/G2 smooth Poisson spline, CV-selected without WCT scores; scale by each file count
systematic_experiment.scope: conditional fitted-smooth-shape simulation; not an instrument-response model or independent null calibration
systematic_experiment.statistic: minimum positive-only locked Q over H2/G1/G2 for degree7 and degree12

uncertainty: event-cluster Poisson sandwich SE, conditional on fitted background and analysis bins; no background/refit uncertainty
